text.tspan: Food is now pulling inflation down.
and silver, is holding it up
Contribution of each group to India's year-on-year CPI inflation, in
percentage points. In December 2025, food subtracted 0.89 points and
personal care added 1.16 points to headline inflation of 1.33%.
Source: MOSPI (CPI, base 2012, All-India combined), Markets by Zerodha
Contributions use MOSPI's 2012-base CPI weights and add up to headline inflation. Personal care and
effects also covers toiletries and other personal items.
